name: Dash Ability
description: A short burst of speed in the input direction, on a cooldown, usable on the ground or in the air. Independent of jumping on purpose: plenty of games have one without the other, and binding them would force a jump into every build that wants a dash. Air dashes are a separate budget from the cooldown, refilled by touching ground, so a player cannot chain them to cross an arbitrary gap.

inputs.name: dashSpeed
inputs.description: Speed during the dash. Three times movement.basic_walk's default walkSpeed, which is the point where a dash reads as a distinct action rather than a sprint.

inputs.name: cooldownSeconds
inputs.description: Measured from the end of the dash, not its start, so shortening the duration does not silently raise the dash rate.

inputs.name: airDashCount
inputs.description: Dashes allowed between touching ground. 0 makes it a ground-only ability.

inputs.name: cancelsVerticalVelocity
inputs.description: Whether an air dash zeroes vertical speed for its duration. True gives the flat, readable dash; false lets a falling dash keep dropping, which is harder to aim.

inputs.name: invulnerableDuringDash
inputs.description: Deliberately off by default. Invulnerability frames turn a movement ability into a defensive one and change every combat encounter, so that has to be asked for.
